objective: Publish one verified blob at a defined workspace-hold linearization point
nonGoals: Defend against the trusted same-UID host controller
acceptanceCriteria: held-publish|WHEN live workspace handle and exact blob are supplied|ASSERT TEST_PASS workspace-blob-writer-tests
linearization|WHEN all durability work completes|ASSERT VALUE "path-open descriptor exact bytes and inode"
short-read|WHEN descriptor returns legal short reads|ASSERT VALUE "exact verified payload"
path-race|WHEN parent or target changes before path-open|ASSERT ERROR WorkspaceBlobIndeterminateError
non-destructive|WHEN target is concurrently replaced|ASSERT VALUE "replacement remains intact"
hold-release|WHEN live hold exit fails after publication|ASSERT ERROR WorkspaceBlobIndeterminateError
no-overwrite|WHEN target already exists|ASSERT ERROR WorkspaceBlobRejectedError
